userScope: Show the checked project first; no production implementation, release activation, database, enhancement curve, commit or push
modelPolicy: 74 conditions use all three rules; 2 immutable-NPC diagnostic conditions use BASELINE only
formula: p_i=H_i*D_i; Q=sum(H_i)*sum(D_i); B=sum_ij min(p_i,p_j); T=max_k k*k*p_desc(k). F_B=Q/2+min(B,Q)/2; F_T=Q/2+min(T,Q)/2. Original NPC Q, factories, constants and target multiplication order unchanged, then exact original target multiplied by F/Q
numericPolicy: Solo and exactly equal H,D return Q directly; Q=0 means F=0,discount=1; stable sorted sums; bounds/clamps and finite checks as frozen manifest
seedPolicy: SHA256(namespace+'/'+groupId+'/'+pair), first48bits big-endian; independent NPC stream used only in explicitly labelled fixed-NPC diagnostic
selectionPriorityBeforeOutcomes: Exact unchanged-production and solo paths are mandatory validity checks
Improve the worst weak-append delta across the three frozen historical risk inputs, not closeness to 50percent or maximum absolute winrate
Reject a clear new major ordinary-append or N8-weak regression, counter-order collapse, advantageous intentional stripping, or effectively free upper levels for ordinary MAIN groups
A specialized valid counter winning often is not automatically free difficulty or a defect
Prefer BLEND_B as the smaller correction if both address the risks with indistinguishable remaining signals
Select at most one candidate for a separately frozen fresh confirmation; if neither is suitable report failure without tuning the half coefficient
inference: 25 mirrored pairs are descriptive, not universal acceptance or a guarantee of monotonic ally benefit; saturated outcomes are not proof of correction
stopping: Exactly this screen. No formula, coefficients, cases, seeds or sample extensions after outcomes. A selected candidate needs a separate fresh-confirmation policy before additional battles. Pilot observations will not be pooled into that confirmation
